title: KULR Secures New $14.8 Million Purchase Order for KULR ONE Max Energy Storage Systems
summary: Today KULR announced it it received a new $14.8 million purchase order...
body_markdown:
**Near-term execution:** $6.2 million of the new purchase order expected to ship in Q4 2026, with the remaining $8.6 million in 2027.


**Commercial momentum:** New $14.8 million order received in Q4 supports KULR ONE Max power-as-a-service deployments in Japan’s growing distributed energy storage market.


**Growth and margin expansion strategy:** Focus is on capturing market share, scaling deliveries, and improving unit economics to drive higher gross margins over time.


**HOUSTON / GLOBENEWSWIRE / November 18, 2026 /[KULR Technology Group, Inc.](https://kulr.ai/)** (NYSE American: KULR) (the “Company” or “KULR”), a developer of safe, high-power energy systems that enable physical AI across energy storage, autonomous systems, space and other mission-critical applications, today announced it received a new $14.8 million purchase order in the fourth quarter 2026 for its KULR ONE Max (K1M) energy storage platform supporting power-as-a-service battery energy storage deployments in Japan. KULR expects to ship $6.2 million of the new order before the end of this year, with the remaining $8.6 million expected in 2027.


“A $14.8 million purchase order underscores the commercial momentum we’re building with KULR ONE Max, our fastest-growing business,” said Michael Mo, Founder and CEO of KULR Technology Group. “Years of investment in battery engineering, safety, and technology innovation are translating into meaningful commercial opportunities and tangible revenue growth.”


**Expanding KULR ONE Max in Japan’s Growing Energy Storage Market**


Japan’s open power market, one of the most advanced in the world, is creating significant opportunities for distributed battery energy storage systems, delivered as power-as-a-service, that can store electricity when demand is low, release power when needed, and help maintain grid stability. These market dynamics are driving demand for safe, reliable energy storage solutions such as KULR ONE Max.


KULR ONE Max is designed for high-capacity storage applications where safety, reliability and operational visibility are essential. KULR combines battery safety engineering and thermal management with state-of-health and state-of-safety monitoring, scalable battery architecture, and lifecycle data that can support uptime, preventative maintenance, warranty management and asset life.


“Japan represents a compelling opportunity as demand for distributed energy storage accelerates,” Mo continued. “Our strategy is to capture market share, establish a meaningful installed base, and move up the value chain with proprietary safety, battery management, monitoring and lifecycle technologies. Over time, we believe that can support higher average selling prices, increased gross margins and more durable recurring revenue opportunities.”


**Focused on Execution and Building a Scalable Energy Storage Business**


This order comes as KULR focuses each of its businesses on customer demand, production and delivery execution, and operational efficiency.


“Our immediate focus is execution and building on the commercial progress we’ve made this year,” Mo concluded. “Our Board and management team are aligned on urgency, commercial discipline, and accountability at every level of the organization, and on leveraging technology and AI to accelerate revenue growth. As we enter 2027, the mandate is clear: turn opportunities into orders, orders into revenue, and revenue into sustainable, profitable growth.”

**About KULR Technology Group, Inc.**
KULR Technology Group, Inc. (NYSE American: KULR) is an energy systems company serving physical AI and other mission-critical applications. Its KULR ONE® Air and KULR ONE® Space battery systems, built in Webster, Texas, serve autonomous systems and space customers.
